summary: Returns true only when both 16-bit texture surface dimensions are positive. Reads two 16-bit fields at +0x28 and +0x2A on the caller-owned object and returns their combined positivity. No callees, no globals, no branches beyond the two comparisons.

operations.description: Require the 16-bit value at this+0x28 (surface dimension 1) to be greater than 0.
Require the 16-bit value at this+0x2A (surface dimension 2) to be greater than 0.
Conjoin both positivity tests; the result is the logical AND of the two guards.
Return true only if both dimensions are positive, otherwise false.

unresolved: Semantic roles of the two dimensions (which is height, which is width) are not established by packet evidence; naming in existing analysis is not an evidence-linked fact.
